## Burning Springs: Scene Random Encounters

***Subject to change pending porting to live servers*** How Random Encounters Work Once a random encounter is triggered, the location enters cooldown for about 18 minutes after all players leave the cell. Each encounter site runs on a “do all before repeating” rule. As long as you stay on the same server without refreshing or rebuilding it, every spawn point will cycle through all of its potential encounters before starting over.
